user.title: Flyt Foresatt
user.description:
1. Log in to {portal} in your browser (ID-porten/BankID).
2. Open developer tools (F12) → Network, reload and click a request to api.foresatt.visma.no.
3. Copy the full value of the "Cookie" request header and paste it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Log in to {portal} again and paste a fresh "Cookie" header from a request to api.foresatt.visma.no.

error.invalid_cookie: No cookies found in the text.
error.invalid_auth: Flyt rejected the session. Log in again and copy the cookie again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Flyt Foresatt.
